Flash Flood Devastates Nepal, Sweeping Away Homes and Bridges

A flash flood triggered by heavy rain and a landslide in Nepal's Gorkha district has swept away over 35 houses and several bridges. The Budhi Gandaki River turned black and grey as the floodwaters inundated villages, leading to mass evacuations. The army has joined rescue operations in the northern region of the country. Separately, heavy rain in Jammu caused flash floods, with one woman reported missing.
